140696: A young human girl who is found by Golem in his forest. She has endless curiosity, which usually gets her in trouble. She wears a hood on her head with minotaur horns to hide her human features since humans are a delicacy in the monster world.
140697: An ancient automaton protector of the forest who stumbles upon Somali while patrolling the woods. He exhibits no emotions, but instinctively protects Somali from any potential threat. He acts like Somali's father and is referred by her as "Dad".
151337: Shizuno works as an herbalist with his assistant Yabashira.
158688: A Woolly Shurigara who runs a diner in Anthole City. He's Kikila's father.
